prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: Betshuva chat sticker and inline emoji atlas; edit target is the attached existing atlas.
Primary request: add stronger, vivid color to the pale illustrations so every small emoji remains clearly visible at 24 pixels. Change only the color fills and color intensity; preserve every existing drawing, expression, object, position, scale, orientation, outline and watercolor texture.
Composition: preserve exactly the existing 8 columns by 6 rows grid, 48 distinct cells, read left to right in each row, with equal-sized cells and the same gutters. No item may move to another cell. Preserve all 16 distinct facial expressions in the first two rows exactly.
Color: make pale cream face discs clearly warm golden yellow, add visible coral-pink cheek blush, saturated rose-red hearts, vivid golden stars and sun, natural warm peach-gold hands, clear blue tears, blue balloons and gifts, green leaves and plants. Increase the existing pale object colors while retaining their original color family. Keep navy dark linework and expressions crisp. Maintain the watercolor character of the source.
Background: actual transparent alpha between and around the existing objects, replacing the almost-white paper; do not paint a checkerboard or a new background. Keep the entire atlas rectangular at the same approximate landscape ratio as the source. Do not add text, numbers, labels, watermarks, decorative frames, new characters, new objects, missing items or duplicates. No redraw of facial geometry. Every original icon must appear exactly once in its original corresponding cell.
Invariants: row 1 happy face, laughing face, smiling face, wink face, kiss face, serene face, face with heart above, star eyes face; row 2 sparkling eyes face, surprised face, skeptical face, thinking face with hand, calm face, worried face, crying face, frustrated face; row 3 single heart, two hearts, thumbs up, OK hand, clapping hands, praying hands, waving hand, raised fist; row 4 check mark, two sparkles, star, fireworks, balloon, gift, party popper, bunting; row 5 sun, sunrise, crescent moon and star, night moon and stars in blue circle, cloud, twig, flower, leaves; row 6 house, open door, window, lantern, winding landscape road, steaming cup, open book, heart outline with twig.

Use case: background-extraction.
Edit target: the attached already-colored Betshuva emoji atlas.
Primary request: remove only the stray yellow/red/blue color flecks, scattered paint residue and ghost pixels between and around the 48 objects. Give clean actual transparent alpha outside each object's real silhouette, with smooth antialiased edges. Keep all colored illustration pixels inside the objects exactly as they are; do not redraw, recolor, resize, alter expressions or shift any object.
Preserve the exact existing 8 columns by 6 rows grid, every object in its current original corresponding cell, and all 48 unique illustrations exactly once. Preserve the vivid golden face discs and their exact facial expressions, colored cheeks, red hearts, blue tears, warm skin hands, colored objects, dark crisp navy outlines and watercolor texture inside objects. Preserve the green check icon's full pale green circular disc, the sunrise full landscape disc, the blue night circle and the landscape road disc. Preserve relevant sun rays, fireworks lines, party confetti, waving lines, leaf twigs, mug steam and all features that belong to the icon. Only floating irrelevant paint speckles or haze outside these actual shapes must be removed.
No text, no labels, no numbers, no new objects, no new backgrounds, no checkerboard, no shadows or glow. The output must retain genuine transparency around all icon silhouettes, landscape aspect ratio, equal grid cell spacing and original positions. Keep grid registration and artwork unchanged.
